If an operator link lands on another page

Some PokerStars links may lead to different destinations by region. A general landing page or another brand does not verify the specific policy, hand ranking, or game rules named in a listing. After opening a source, check its publisher and heading. If they differ, do not treat the redirected page as the cited authority.

For learning, use our hand-ranking guide or the variant guide. For restrictions on study tools, begin with rules and fair play, then confirm the operator's currently applicable policy before using a tool. The original source URLs are retained; no alternate operator is endorsed.
